mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, u.name as studentName, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, j.address, j.salary, wa.status, j.userId as merchantId FROM work_assignment wa INNER JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id INNER JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND DATE(wa.work_date) = CURRENT_DATE() AND wa.status IN ('assigned', 'checked_in', 'pending_confirmation', 'cancelled') ORDER BY wa.time_slot, u.name

SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, u.name as studentName, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, j.address, j.salary, wa.status, j.userId as merchantId, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.attendance_status, a.work_minutes FROM work_assignment wa INNER JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id INNER JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND wa.status IN ('assigned', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'cancelled') ORDER BY wa.work_date DESC, wa.time_slot

SELECT wa.*, j.title as jobTitle, u.name as studentName, j.userId as merchantId FROM work_assignment wa INNER JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id INNER JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id WHERE wa.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_assignment ( student_id, job_id, merchant_requirement_id, work_date, time_slot, status ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{jobId}, 0, #{workDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, j.address, j.salary, wa.status FROM work_assignment wa INNER JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} AND wa.status = 'assigned' ORDER BY wa.work_date DESC, wa.time_slot

SELECT wa.id, wa.student_id, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, wa.status, u.name as studentName FROM work_assignment wa JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id WHERE wa.job_id = #{jobId} AND wa.status IN ('assigned', 'checked_in') ORDER BY u.name, wa.work_date

SELECT wa.student_id, u.name as studentName, u.credit, j.title as lastJobTitle, wa.work_date as lastWorkDate, wa.id as lastWorkAssignmentId, j.id as lastJobId FROM work_assignment wa JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND wa.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND (wa.student_id, wa.id) IN ( SELECT wa2.student_id, MAX(wa2.id) FROM work_assignment wa2 JOIN job j2 ON wa2.job_id = j2.id WHERE j2.userId = #{merchantId} AND wa2.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') GROUP BY wa2.student_id ) ORDER BY wa.work_date DESC

SELECT wa.id, wa.student_id, wa.job_id, wa.time_slot, wa.work_date, wa.status, j.title as jobTitle, j.salary, j.address, j.remunerationType, j.userId as merchantId, j.recruitmentLimit, u.name as merchantName, u.phone as merchantPhone FROM work_assignment wa JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id JOIN user u ON j.userId = u.id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} AND wa.status IN ('assigned', 'checked_in', 'pending_confirmation') ORDER BY j.id, wa.work_date, wa.time_slot
